storyline.real: Alesi's Tyrrell leads the first 33 laps; Senna passes on lap 34, Alesi takes it back, Senna passes again a lap later and wins by 8.7 seconds
storyline.headline: The Tyrrell beat the McLaren on the streets of Phoenix

mastery.label: Push for no more than 10 laps

eras.briefing: Phoenix, 1990, the season opener. Alesi started fourth in the Tyrrell and led from the first corner, with Senna's McLaren behind. Pit board only: tell him when to push. Reconstructed race: no lap timing survives, so the laps are rebuilt to fit the result, the fastest laps and the sourced stops (Jolpica, F1DB, Motor Sport, Wikipedia). The lap-by-lap gaps and running order are synthetic, not history.
